features: Flexible Designer: independent Desktop/Tablet/Mobile layouts for free-canvas sections — each breakpoint is now a fully separate, independently authored canvas (own blocks, own layout) instead of a scaled or reflowed view of Desktop. Existing sections are unaffected until a breakpoint is explicitly customized. Note: Content Height Mode and Screen Limit are still shared across all three breakpoints for now, and a section with an empty Desktop layout shows nothing at any screen size even if Tablet/Mobile have content
